af9b2d80f9:
Just crashing Axis into Earth will do damage on the scale
of a nuclear winter. That's an atrocity no dictator
has ever committed, you know?
bc60eb2563:
Spare me the sermon now, Nanai. I believe in the evolution
of mankind that went into space. But to make all mankind
Newtypes, someone must bear the burden of mankind's sins.
b818878c5c:
Is that really all right...?
Didn't you come up with this operation
just to get back at that Amuro, Captain?
be1ea91977: Heh... Am I such a small man?
7ca1bba35e:
Amuro Ray is a man who mistakes kindness for a Newtype's
weapon. A woman can forgive such a man, but you,
Captain, cannot forgive Amuro...
584d9e6605:
All right, a three-stage defense!
I'm sorry, but give me all your lives...!
89b9c69b42:
The Captain is still haunted by Lalah, the pilot he used
in the One Year War. Plenty of women have heard him
say "Lalah Sune" in his sleep!
2479519272:
I'm not listening to your jealousy!
I'm the one who'll chase out Nanai and Lalah!
985e7fb5c5:
The Captain started this war
because Amuro took Lalah from him!
8c0b2269fa: That's exactly why I hate young men!
cf6aa3ce3e:
Gyunei, why would you think I'd lay a hand on Quess?
I have no interest beyond rebuilding Neo Zeon and
defeating Amuro... Besides, Nanai is kind to me.
733ed185f8:
(Lalah, whom I favored, found the kindness she had
 been seeking in my enemy, Amuro.
 I know that was the empathy between Newtypes.)
aa422d677f:
(Ah, I wanted her to guide me...
 Only because I could sense people's wills...)
e515050dd3:
Captain, I won't stop you anymore, but...
Once you defeat Amuro...
fc8fce21cf:
I know. After that, I'll do as you say, Nanai.
Sazabi, launching!
62e9efd543:
Char's plan to bring on a global winter had entered its
final stage. Through secret talks with the Federation,
Neo Zeon secured Axis in exchange for its fleet's surrender.
0da5adca42:
But the surrender was a ruse. The Neo Zeon fleet
raided Luna II and seized its stockpiled nuclear
weapons, intending to load them onto Axis.
c9bf219eef:
Passion, madness or despair... Char's goal was to make
Earth uninhabitable, purge those who clung to it, and send
the rest of mankind to space to evolve into Newtypes.
9ca808aa7b:
He spoke of a great cause, but wasn't he really obsessed
with his showdown with Amuro?
Some of his men suspected as much.
342d4a087f:
Londo Bell, always a step behind, planned to hit Axis's
power with mobile suits and nuclear missiles, and if that
failed, to get inside and destroy it.
6bc2b1f863:
At last the final battle between Neo Zeon and Londo Bell
begins. Char entrusts Quess with the giant mobile armor
Alpha Azieru, and assigns Gyunei as her escort.
bf818cf07c:
Infatuated with Char, Quess sorties gleefully.
But Gyunei, who has feelings for her, cannot shake
his doubts about Char, and warns her.
d9ad918411:
Quess shakes Gyunei off, intent on fighting only for
Char. Yet even she seemed to be no more than
one of Char's pawns.
6fe970bf47:
Though Char sensed traces of Lalah in Quess, he
rejected her search for a father figure. Half using
her, he aimed only to settle things with Amuro.
8ec110e1d2:
The one who might have guided him... Losing Lalah
had cast a dark shadow over his lonely heart.
720bff0c1f:
What... is that light...!?
What's happening!? Observe it more closely!
2fba7de533:
Could that be what Chan was talking about...
the psycoframe resonance...?
Amuro, is that you...?
5ce697974e:
Ah... Captain!
Your life... is being drained away...
fd1c41c14b:
The light emitted by the Nu Gundam envelops Axis.
On the bridge of the Ra Cailum,
Bright cannot hide his bewilderment.
58b19ba501:
Axis, which was falling toward Earth, drifts off
into the depths of space, as if guided by the light.
50b40e9bed:
The psycoframe's light became like a rainbow across space.
...Embodying Amuro's will to show humanity's potential,
it may truly have been the light of the human heart.
7d43d8b514:
Without Char, the remaining Neo Zeon fleet withdrew,
ending the Second Neo Zeon War. The light phenomenon
would later be called the "Axis Shock."
1d54764ec7:
Amuro Ray and Char Aznable.
No one ever saw either of them again...
